description: This file defines the Scope class used for script execution in a build system, including scope management, variable handling, templates, and properties.

classes.name: Scope
classes.description: Manages variable scopes for script execution, supporting nested scopes, variable access, templates, properties, and build dependencies.

classes.name: Scope::ProgrammaticProvider
classes.description: Provides a mechanism for code to supply values for built-in variables within a scope.

classes.name: Scope::MergeOptions
classes.description: Configures options for merging scopes, such as clobbering existing variables and excluding certain values.

classes.name: Scope::TemplateInvocationEntry
classes.description: Stores information about a template invocation, including template name, target name, and location.

methods.name: Scope::Describe
methods.description: Returns a string describing the template invocation.

methods.name: Scope::SetProcessingBuildConfig
methods.description: Sets the flag indicating processing of a build configuration file.

methods.name: Scope::ClearProcessingBuildConfig
methods.description: Clears the build config processing flag.

methods.name: Scope::IsProcessingBuildConfig
methods.description: Checks if currently processing a build configuration file.

methods.name: Scope::SetProcessingImport
methods.description: Sets the flag indicating processing of an import file.

methods.name: Scope::IsProcessingImport
methods.description: Checks if currently processing an import file.
